nemo_tools.purpose: Recover large evidence referenced by a portfolio.

nemo_tools.purpose: Update NEMO utility signals after use.

nemo_tools.purpose: Inspect context portfolio health and token savings.

nemo_tools.name: compress_context_artifact
nemo_tools.purpose: Compact large outputs while preserving recoverable evidence.

nemo_tools.name: update_memory
nemo_tools.purpose: Update curated memory after review resolves stale facts.

nemo_tools.name: store_conversation
nemo_tools.purpose: Persist meaningful task exchanges and outcomes.

nemo_tools.name: get_recent_context
nemo_tools.purpose: Inspect recent raw conversation when compact context is insufficient.

nemo_tools.purpose: Inspect NEMO health when memory behavior is suspicious.
